note: RV park off Shelton Cove Road, Waynesville, in the Smoky Mountain foothills, minutes from Cataloochee Valley and Maggie Valley; cable TV at every site, on-site RV repair, winterizing and storage. Directory listings mention a clubhouse with laundry and a firepit. --Claude
